scope_note: The controlled-substance frame: schedules, how federal and Massachusetts law combine, and Schedule III-V refills and transfers. All three were public under content model 1 and were re-authored under model 2 in PR #153; no earlier audit binds any hash frozen here. Scope-gate signals answered before freezing. Declined: FED-CIII-V-REFILL against SG-CIII-V-REFILL-TRANSFER and SG-FED-MA-INTERACTION restates 21 CFR 1306.22(a) alongside FED-CS-REFILL-III-IV, which SG-CIII-V-REFILL-TRANSFER already cites; it is frozen by four RELEASED adjudications and cannot be consolidated, and citing both would duplicate one proposition. FED-CS-SCHEDULES against SG-CIII-V-REFILL-TRANSFER is taught in a section frozen in this same package, so the auditor sees both sides of the seam (SG-CONTROLLED-SCHEDULES). The M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(d) family against SG-FED-MA-INTERACTION (MA-CII-OUTSTATE, MA-OUTSTATE-CII-DEPARTMENT-COPY, MA-OUTSTATE-CII-NARCOTIC, MA-OUTSTATE-VERIFICATION-DUTIES) is the declared subject of SG-MA-OUTSTATE-PRESCRIPTIONS. MA-RX-FAILOVER-ORAL and MA-RX-WRITTEN-FORMAT are 'Prescription format' topic adjacency, taught in SG-MA-ORAL-PRESCRIPTIONS and SG-MA-SCHEDULE-VI.
